reviewer_relationship: Follow-up technical review by the same conversational assistant; not independent author review.

added_regressions.interpretation: Red regression failures expose unresolved candidate behavior; not an acceptance PASS.

findings.title: Standalone verification does not enforce the selected fixture profile
findings.observed: With correct controller digests for deliberately invalid samples, staging rejects restricted sensitivity, added repository_write capability, weakened envelope fields, and an unknown packet version. Standalone verification reports schema_check=passed for all four. With weakened fields, timestamp_utc is missing from the returned envelope.
findings.qualification: No trusted digest was bypassed. This tests conformance independently from integrity; it does not demonstrate a confidentiality breach or unauthorized execution. Every report still says authority_effect=none and handoff_ready=false.
findings.repair: Factor pure, immutable profile validation out of time-dependent eligibility. Require it in both entry points; use a pinned, reviewed profile rather than letting the packet choose a weaker schema. Historical read-back must not renew a grant or fail merely because a valid historical grant has since expired.

findings.title: Replay treats terminal-record existence as a valid delivery decision
findings.observed: An empty delivered.json and a delivered.json containing transport_only=false both produce normal duplicate_suppressed results.
findings.qualification: The reproduction does not cause a second delivery. It shows incomplete or contradictory outcome evidence is accepted as an ordinary completed duplicate.
findings.repair: Read the terminal record using bounded, no-symlink handling; validate its exact expected contents and relationship to the immutable claim. Missing, empty, malformed, or contradictory records must remain explicitly held.

findings.title: A final deadline failure is not retained for replay
findings.observed: A synthetic monotonic clock crosses the deadline after delivered.json has been written. The first call raises elapsed_budget, but the next call returns ordinary duplicate_suppressed without preserving the late/failed outcome.
findings.qualification: This is loss of terminal outcome provenance, not duplicate execution. Bytes were staged; the result must distinguish delivered bytes from an on-time successful operation. Concurrent writers and host-crash durability were not exercised.
findings.repair: Specify the commit/decision point and preserve late or uncertain terminal outcomes. A failed final check must prevent a later unqualified success-like replay result. Allow explicit held/late reporting without erasing bytes or automatically retrying. Moving a check alone is not proof of correct post-write behavior.

findings.title: Malformed nested input escapes the stable boundary-error contract
findings.observed: inputs=[17], with a matching synthetic controller digest, raises AttributeError instead of a stable BoundaryError.
findings.qualification: The operation stops; this is not permission widening. It weakens predictable failure evidence and error handling.
findings.repair: Check the type of each nested object before using dictionary methods. Return a stable fixture_input or explicitly versioned validation code, preserving raw input separately.

findings.title: Numeric overflow bypasses the non-finite JSON guard
findings.observed: decode on the literal bytes {"elapsed":1e999} returns a Python infinity. The parse_constant hook rejects NaN/Infinity tokens but does not cover this numeric conversion.
findings.qualification: The fixed original fixture does not use this numeric field. No routing or execution impact was demonstrated. This is a parser-hardening issue before broader structured inputs are accepted.
findings.repair: Reject non-finite parsed numbers at all nesting levels, through a finite-checking numeric parser or an explicit post-parse walk. Keep the error stable and test exponent overflow as well as nonstandard constant tokens.

next_valid_action: A separate local repair candidate and rerun; then independent review of the repaired exact bytes. Do not bind a live transport yet.
